blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Friday ordered the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to identify the individual who posed as one of the court’s justices in order to solicit money from the son of a co-accused in the plunder case of former Speaker Martin Romualdez. In its order, the court said it received an urgent manifestation from the Office of the Ombudsman regarding an individual who was posing as the chair of the Third Division, Associate Justice Karl Miranda. The person reportedly introduced himself as Miranda in a telephone call with the son of Samchan Foreign Exchange Corp. […]...
